thread:
lina: seeing a weird spike on console during canary — SSE pingback debounce seems to double-count route->quota. Anyone else?
sam: yep saw same. Metrics show duplicate keepalive hits from proxy around 23:10 UTC. Console flagged quota overrun but no requests in logs :thinking: 
devon: Do you have the proxy logs? I suspect pingback handler + resume flow both emitting 'keepalive' telemetry.
lina: attaching snippets in a sec. repro steps: start stream, kill socket, proxy sends preflight pingback, client reconnects and resume emits keepalive -> double billing in dashboard.
ben: that's the telemetry side — we tag events by flow_id but proxy pingbacks are missing flow_id so server creates a new one. Console dedupe expects flow_id, hence duplicate trace.
maria: UX: console shows per-route quota spike and a rollout alert. PM asked if we should throttle alerts for ephemeral pingback noise.
devon: quick workaround: don't emit quota-charge metric on proxy-origin keepalive until resume confirms session. patch idea: add header `X-Ping-Origin: proxy` and skip charging.
lina: @devon can you paste the curl I used? I had a minimal repro.
devon: sure — here's the minimal repro I ran:
```bash
# repro client
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?route=test' --limit-rate 1k
# kill connection, then re-open
```
devon: I'll try a canary patch to skip charging on keepalive when header present. will also add metric tag `keepalive_source`.
ben: please add a telemetry fallback: prefer flow_id if present, fall back to session_id but mark events as POSSIBLE_DUP. gives console safer dedupe.
maria: if we add that tag, console should suppress alerts for spikes <30s and surface a 'probable pingback noise' banner. I'll mock the banner copy.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for devon/skip-proxy-charge (build #5463) :rocket: 
devon: canary up on eu-prod-edge-2. monitoring: latency ok, token_count down ~0.2% — looks promising.
lina: if stable for 30m let's promote. also need retro note + dashboard annotation for affected window.
ben: i'll run a backfill to recompute affected billing windows and tag samples. ETA ~2h.
maria: cool, i'll mute the rollout alert until backfill finishes and add changelog entry. :white_check_mark: 
sam: logging note: we should bubble the original proxy trace_id into the resume path so dedupe becomes trivial.
devon: agree. long-term: unify keepalive/event taxonomy across proxy/runtime and require flow_id propagation. opened PR #7890 for trace propagation.
lina: thanks team. follow-ups: PR review for skip-charge, telemetry flag, console mute, and retro doc. i'll create tickets and assign.
maria: adding tickets to the rollout board now.
